name: Observation-operator geometry and instrument-coordinate verification
purpose: Verify LOS/tangent/spacecraft transforms and instrument coordinate conventions before comparing observations.
configuration: One fixed, metadata-backed geometry case per instrument; SPICE kernels and aberration convention explicit.
independent_reference: SPICE round trips, analytical tangent geometry, and archive geometry fields.
units: UTC/ET, m, radians/degrees as explicitly converted
frame_time_convention: J2000, instrument, IAU_MOON, and LSO transforms named with aberration correction.
procedure: Check normalized boresights, transform round trips, tangent points/altitudes, occultations, bin/FOV footprints, and serialized geometry.
acceptance_criteria: Norm/rotation error <=1e-13; physical position/tangent tolerance must be frozen from source geometry precision.
expected_pass_result: Each operator reproduces its independent geometry before science values are scored.
data_hashes: not evaluated because no single instrument case is fully configured
status_semantics: SKIPPED until a production operator, kernels, and authoritative geometry case are selected.
skip_reason: SPICE is disabled; Kaguya uses embedded legacy tables and the other requested instrument operators are absent.
missing_capability: Qualified per-instrument geometry adapters using production operators.
